meta.name: Oil / Gas OCF-Led Low-Vol Value V5.8b
meta.objective: Retest oil/gas as an OCF-led value sleeve with low-volatility support and valuation discipline after V5.8a showed the first composite underperformed OCF-only.

universe.name: A-share oil/gas upstream, integrated, refining, natural-gas processing and distribution candidates
universe.construction: V5.8a PIT universe from JoinQuant HY01103, HY01104, HY01105 and HY01106. HY01102 oilfield services remain excluded.

data.vendor: JoinQuant/DataJQ PIT financial fields + V5.8a futures-proxy external state + JQ industry-exposure proxy + V5 low-vol panel
data.external_state_policy: preliminary futures proxies only; allowed for research validation but not formal promotion
data.business_exposure_policy: PIT JoinQuant industry membership proxy only; annual-report segment review is still required

price_adjustment.low_vol_panel: raw daily close history strictly before trade_date

data.source_warning: V5.8b is a research validation candidate. It cannot be promoted without official spot/spread/tariff sources, reviewed business exposure and cash dividend event repair.

factors.name: operating_cash_flow_yield
factors.definition: Operating cash flow divided by market capitalization.

factors.name: low_vol_score
factors.source: daily close returns strictly before trade_date
factors.definition: Composite of negative realized volatility, downside volatility and max drawdown.

factors.name: low_price_to_book
factors.definition: Lower PB is preferred as valuation discipline.

factors.name: pe_ratio
factors.definition: Lower PE is preferred, with cyclical earnings caveat.

factors.name: dividend_yield
factors.definition: Visible dividend yield, diagnostic until cash dividend events are repaired.

factors.name: free_cash_flow_yield
factors.definition: Operating cash flow minus capex, divided by market capitalization.

factors.name: capex_burden
factors.definition: Cash paid for fixed / intangible assets divided by operating cash flow.

scoring.value_trap_guard: No hard guard is approved. Dividend, FCF and capex burden are retained as diagnostics only.

schedule.rebalance_rule: first tradable day of quarter after PIT visibility check

portfolio.cash_policy: hold residual cash when fewer than eight names pass filters

defensive_rule.reason: V5.8b is a research PIT validation candidate, not a timing model.

individual_stop_loss_take_profit.reason: Fixed exits are not part of the research hypothesis.

validation.acceptance_rule: V5.8b can only decide whether oil/gas deserves deeper source repair. It cannot become an accepted strategy from 2021-2026 results.
